add_definitions(
        "-D_INC_STRING_S"
        "-D_INC_WCHAR_S"
        "-D_SECIMP=//"
        "-D_STDIO_S_DEFINED"
        "-D_INC_STDIO_S"
        "-D_INC_STDLIB_S"
        "-D_INC_MEMORY_S")

set(libsec_sources
        "src/fscanf_s.c"
        "src/fwscanf_s.c"
        "src/gets_s.c"
        "src/memcpy_s.c"
        "src/memmove_s.c"
        "src/memset_s.c"
        "src/scanf_s.c"
        "src/securecutil.c"
        "src/secureinput_a.c"
        "src/secureinput_w.c"
        "src/secureprintoutput_a.c"
        "src/secureprintoutput_w.c"
        "src/snprintf_s.c"
        "src/sprintf_s.c"
        "src/sscanf_s.c"
        "src/strcat_s.c"
        "src/strcpy_s.c"
        "src/strncat_s.c"
        "src/strncpy_s.c"
        "src/strtok_s.c"
        "src/swprintf_s.c"
        "src/swscanf_s.c"
        "src/vfscanf_s.c"
        "src/vfwscanf_s.c"
        "src/vscanf_s.c"
        "src/vsnprintf_s.c"
        "src/vsprintf_s.c"
        "src/vsscanf_s.c"
        "src/vswprintf_s.c"
        "src/vswscanf_s.c"
        "src/vwscanf_s.c"
        "src/wcscat_s.c"
        "src/wcscpy_s.c"
        "src/wcsncat_s.c"
        "src/wcsncpy_s.c"
        "src/wcstok_s.c"
        "src/wmemcpy_s.c"
        "src/wmemmove_s.c"
        "src/wscanf_s.c"
        )

        libsec_shared

        ${libsec_sources}
)
set(LIBRARY_OUTPUT_PATH ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/output/lib/dsoftbus)

        include
)
